title: Contact form
description: Canada.ca form: labelled fields with required markers, textarea, primary submit. Bilingual parity required.

components.reason: Email address with required marker and autocomplete
Submit — the only primary button on the page

nesting: Components 1-2 are self-contained (form-group wrapper included); component 3 closes the form
validationOrder: Required fields marked with '(required)' in the label
Errors: has-error on the form-group plus inline error text with role='alert' — Canada.ca has no page-level error summary
Every label string exists in English and French
a11yNotes: Inline error text must use role='alert' to be announced
Bilingual parity: the equivalent French page must exist and be linked
agentPromptSequence: 1. Build each field as a form-group with label + form-control
3. Provide both EN and FR label strings for every field
4. On failure, switch the group to has-error and add inline error text
